title: Decompose RSO-METHODS-SLICE-001 (S1-S5) into the C-004 work graph
objective: Turn the S1-S5 slice into self-contained task packets under ops/campaigns/C-004/tasks/, each with owner, capability class, dependencies, owned/read-only files, RED evidence, acceptance and deliverables, so that Argus, Cadmus, Eupalamus and (for narrow attack packets) Pallas can claim work without a briefing.
problem: The slice exists as a plan (NEXT_ROUND_PLAN_v0.4) and a closure review with mandatory amendments C1-C5, but not as claimable work. Likely areas (directive s11): frozen contract/schema; finite truth model; producer receipt; consumer/checker; evidence graph; reset model; observer model; authority stage; anchor/custody interface; sound fixtures; broken fixtures; semantic mutation support; reporting; integration tests.
non_goals: No implementation of S1-S5 components in this task (other packets do that)
No redesign of the RSO and no reopening of the closed design review
No Q3 packets for routine work; Pallas gets only narrow attack packets on frozen surfaces
evidence_required: python -m workgraph validate passes with the new packets
a coverage table in CAMPAIGN.md mapping every S1 contract item, C1-C5, T01-T08, E01-E06 and S2-S5 deliverable to >= 1 packet

acceptance.command: python -m workgraph validate && python -m workgraph status C-004
acceptance.condition: every S1-S5 deliverable and C1-C5, T01-T08, E01-E05 (E06 reported, not an exit criterion) is covered by a packet with owner, quality_class, dependencies and acceptance; S1 packets are READY; open operator decisions OP-1..OP-3 are represented (escalations or OPERATOR_DECISION packets) where they gate work

escalation_triggers: an S1 item cannot be specified without a scientific decision the sources do not make
caps (OP-1) or anchor keeper (OP-2) block every S2 packet
